## Expression on this line

The Health line at amber Stage 9 is the **industrial biomedical order, ascriptively gated**. A
society's biomedical-industrial machine has consolidated: hospitals, primary-care networks,
maternity-and-child-health infrastructure, immunization machinery, an industrial pharmaceutical
sector, biomedical-research institutions, and *public-health* campaigns exist and function at
industrial scale. There is a *standing* public-health system organized as part of the modern
state's infrastructure and a large private biomedical sector serving paying-customer-clients.
What has not yet emerged is the operating principle that health care is distributed by universal
medical need rather than by in-group standing (this is the orange breakthrough at Stage 11+).

The constitutive choice is to make access to biomedical service conditional on *membership in the
membership-defined polity* — by kin, ethnos, religion, sect, tribe, class, civic-credential,
or paid-customer status. Health care is treated as a *service to members* rather than as a
public-domain whose regulation is itself a watershed subject. Public-health policy frames its
public-good arguments in terms of *protecting the public* (i.e. the in-group) rather than in
terms of *protecting each individual's standing biomedically*.

## Integrity markers (healthy inclusion — what a higher CoG must keep from amber-9)

- **UL:** the practitioner's professional competence-identity — *we can do medical work,
  competently*; service-vocation internalized as part of identity; clinical-discipline that
  any higher stage can build upon.
- **UR:** large-scale standing biomedical infrastructure: hospitals, primary-care networks,
  immunization campaigns, biomedical-research apparatus, industrial pharmaceutical sector.
- **LL:** shared-commitment to biomedical-scientific-naturalism as a common *civic-modern*
  reference-frame; the civic-religion-around-modern-vaccination that earlier stages cannot
  produce.
- **LR:** codified regulatory frame, licensing regimes, professional self-regulation, public-
  health-emergency statutory authority.

## Pathology markers (Agape / Eros)

- **Dark addiction (clinging to amber-9):** **biomedical-as-gate to membership** — biomedical
  care is unconditional-on-membership availability in form, while access is class-correlated
  in fact; the public-health rhetoric *protects the public* (the in-group) rather than *protects
  individuals*.
- **Dark allergy (amber-9 foundation skipped/fragile):** biomedical-industrial scale without
  standing biomedical-institutional discipline; industrial-pharmaceutical capacity with
  insufficient regulatory discipline; lab-capacity-with-no-licensing-system.
- **Golden addiction (grasping Orange prematurely):** **universal-care-theater** — performative
  universal-coverage language on a system that is gated-by-class in practice; a single legally-
  declared right-statute whose delivery is group-correlated; individual redress statistically
  traceable to class-membership rather than to clinical need.
- **Golden allergy (Jonah / refusing the Orange emergence):** *the in-group takes care of its
  own, and refuses to recognize that biomedical care is a public-domain subject to rights-
  equal-procedure*. Refusing the worldcentric turn that would subordinate in-group care to
  universal-care-as-equal-procedure.

## Diagnostic cues (universal signal-types)

Falsifiable signal *types* that place a health-system holon at **amber Stage 9**.

- **Coverage-to-outcome correlation by class.** Correlated coverage-deciles to outcome-deciles
  across class-axes (income, geography, ethnos, religion) including measures of a tightly
  biomedical-amenable condition's lethality.
- **Protect-public health-rhetoric default.** Published public-health framing routinely
  references "the public" (in-group, civilizational whole, or paying-customer-pool) rather than
  "each person" or "any person within the jurisdiction" as the *operative* unit of analysis.
- **Conditional-access regulatory regime.** Conditional-access statutes for biomedical
  infrastructure, license regimes for biomedical-services, dues/access-tied to civic-membership
  category, payment-correlation with access.
- **Public-health-discourse underlying-asymmetry stat.** Racial-patients, lower-class-patients,
  lower-class-prognosis audit-cited; underlying-class-status-correlated with access-audit.
- **Sectoral-protectionism industrial pharmaceutical-statistical.** Industrial-pharmaceutical
  sector protected-needs-controls that constrain generic-access, generic-affordability, and
  generic-pricing-tied-population.
- **Procedural workups for non-medicine-feasibility.** When *clinical* attention to
  social-determinants appears as ad-hoc-as-patients-tribute-stat-speak rather than
  system-level-discipline.
- **Class-correlated-disparity statistical trending.** Routine publication of class-correlated
  stats on access outcomes, with no system-level redress-action commentary.

## Sources, joints, open questions

- **Sources:** Wilber, *Integral Psychology* (altitude/amber); Beck & Cowan, *Spiral Dynamics*
  (ethnocentric-stabilization); Commons/MHC Order 8 (Primary); Kegan, *In Over Our Heads*
  (order 3 → 4); Engel, *The Biopsychosocial Model*; WHO World-Health-Report series at the
  generic-form level; CSDH (Commission on Social Determinants of Health); Marmot, *The Health
  Gap*; Brandt & Rozin, *Morality and Health*; Rapp, *Testing Women, Testing the Fetus*;
  applicable work on medical-industrial complex (generic-form, no country-specific reference).

- **Open joints:** What institutional features carry the amber Stage 9 health system's
  *positive* civic-modern moments (the standing-infrastructure-for-services, the shared
  biomedical-scientific-naturalism frame at LL) into a higher orange or green cycle? What
  structural pre-conditions are required for a health-system to dismount the loyalty-gating
  of membership without destabilizing the standing-infrastructure-the-public-good
  functions?
